tool_args.rationale: The verified bridge indicates a two-layer siphon, but the observations are confined to H = 0.6 and do not identify its dynamics. A fine trajectory batch can distinguish temporal mechanisms before numerical fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All seven observations share one horizon, and only two vary the gradient; they cannot identify the two-layer temporal response or reliably distinguish gradient dependence.
Already acquired; its two added rows do not resolve the temporal ambiguity.
The nuisance measurement is unrelated to identifying the transfer law.
